voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Georgetown, South Carolina. The last day of eighteen twelve. The schooner Patriot sailed for New York.
Aboard: Theodosia Burr Alston, Aaron Burr's daughter, the governor's wife. She never reached New York.
Neither the ship nor anyone aboard was ever found. Two days out, a storm was logged off the Carolina coast.
Later came stories of pirates, of wreckers luring ships ashore, of confessions. None was ever proven.
In eighteen sixty-nine, a woman's portrait turned up on the Outer Banks. Some say it is her. It has never been confirmed.
